findings.description: "upgrade as the note at the top says" depends on the Unreleased entry staying in the same file as that note. When a release cuts, the entry moves under a version heading and the note may no longer be "at the top" of the reader's view. Stating the key step in the entry would make it stand alone, for example "delete the workflow and re-scaffold with `ci-review`, as the note at the top describes". This is optional, and the current wording is not wrong today.
